lines.en: She did wind up falling asleep, but she wouldn’t let me carry her back.

I offered, of course. I can’t imagine she weighs more than a large backpack. And considering I carry the burden of thousands if not millions of years of having my mind rewritten, I don’t think it’d be a problem.
We stopped by our gazebo, but only for a few minutes. Only out of habit.
It’s nearly 3:00 AM now. And while I feel bad for keeping her out so long, I’ve come to accept that she wants this.

Why she wants this, I’ll never be able to understand. But of course that’s just me telling myself I’ll never be able to understand when, in all actuality, I was just like her once. Just more physical and less virtual.
I know what it’s like to want someone you shouldn’t. And while that’s taken on a new meaning as I’ve gotten older, I’ve sort of always been that way.
Uta can still grow out of it, though. There’s a chance she realizes once more how close to destruction she is. There’s a chance I could be the next one physically harmed for wanting her.
But there’s a problem.
I don’t want to protect her. I want to hurt her. Every day. Every night. Every minute for the rest of my life — because there is something different here. I just...
I haven’t figured out how to explain it yet.
: I had fun tonight, Sensei.
: I’d hope so considering how late I kept you out.
: If anything, I’d say that I’m the one who kept you out by dragging you across town to a secret tunnel and then falling asleep in your lap.
: Yeah, I guess so. But on the bright side, the break in flirting gave my penis a chance to not be erect anymore. So that’s cool.
: Reaaaaaally? Even though you’re right outside of my room?
: I sure am. But this is just one more night of unending temptation since I know you aren’t actually going to invite me in.
: So? Doesn’t mean there won’t be fantasies. I know just how much you adore Uta and Uta-chan. There is no escape from the effect I have on your penis.
: Same goes for you and the way you look at me then.
: You wanna know what I’m gonna do when I get inside, Akira?...
: Yes. A thousand times, yes.
: Pass the frick out, that’s what. I’m still eepy from the lap-nap. And I’ve gotta wake up to get ready for school in like two hours.
: A tease right up ‘til the end. Like always.
: That won’t ever change either.
: Not even if we were together?
: Probably more if we were together. Teasing you makes me happy. It’s how I check to see you’re still interested. And the fact that you still are after all you’ve learned...
: That means a lot to me.
: I hope we get to wake up next to each other some day.
: There’s always two hours from now.
: Oh, please. We both know neither one of us would get to sleep at all if you came in tonight.
: Yeah...
: I guess I...should just let you go then.
: Should you?
: I mean, yeah. You’re tired. I’m tired. And if I don’t jerk off after all of this teasing, I think my dick is going to actually explode.
: Hm.
: Why? Second thoughts at work again? Am I actually going to be invited in after all?
: I just think you’re forgetting something.
: Forgetting something?
: Mhm~
: You know I’m not gonna make the first move. That’s all on you, buddy.
: You...want me to kiss you?
: Seems like a fitting way to end the night, doesn’t it? And you’ve missed a million other chances so far, so I figured I might give you a hint this time.
: Is there a problem? Because I know you want me. And you know I want you. So what’s the hold-up?
: The hold-up is I won’t be able to stop myself.
: Sure you will.
: I think you underestimate just how badly I want to fuck you right now.
: I think you underestimate just how much you actually like me.
: And because you like me, I know you aren’t going to do anything I’m not ready for.
: Either way — worst case scenario is I’m wrong and I finally get to live out my number one fantasy of sleeping with you. I can’t really lose, can I?
Standing right in front of her always makes me feel like a giant — yet she’s the one who seems confident right now.
I guess knowing what you want and only wanting one thing can do that to a person.
I’m the type who wants everything, though. So while I’ve become very skilled in terms of separating myself from other desires in moments like this, I’m still not great at just accepting them.
But maybe...
I can convince myself there is only one thing I want.
And that it’s something she can give me.
Someone I can grow old with and die before.
Someone who will tease me by day and pet me by night. Who will stay faithful so long as I am.
Someone who can help me and hold me and a million other things I can already do with other people I have and know, but-
Again...
Something just feels different.
: The height disparity makes this difficult.
: The best things in life normally are.
: You’re sure about this?
: More sure than you are, apparently. I’d have caved already if I was in your shoes.
: But I fall hard and I fall quickly, so...maybe I’m just hoping I’ll be caught this time.
: Uta Ushibori.
: Akira Arakawa.
: I do not have a ring...and I can not promise you that I am worthy of your time or capable of remaining loyal to you. Do you accept this?
: Yes. But know that I plan on crying a lot every time you break my heart in an effort to make you stop.

: I will not protect you...nor will I abandon you. You will give yourself to me and only me...and you will receive nothing in return. I can not make you happy and I can not sit still. Do you accept this?
: Yes. I will give myself to you and only you. But it’s not like I won’t be getting anything back. It’s time for me to invest in you for a change.
: By entering into this unofficial covenant with me, you are hereby renouncing your quality as a human being and greatly reducing your self-worth. Do you accept?
: Yes. You’ve always made me sound more valuable than I actually am anyway.
: Any more questions?
: One more...and it’s big.
: I’m ready.
: Do you love me?
: Yes...
: A thousand times, yes...
And so one more wish comes true in this world of infinite possibilities.
But each and every one comes with a caveat.
: Mmm!
For Uta Ushibori abhorred the idea of entering into any covenant with someone who didn’t plan on remaining loyal to her and her alone.
But in her mind, if this was the only way it could ever happen, she was willing to make certain concessions.
After all, it was like she said — the best things in life normally are difficult. And the fact that he was honest about this up front must count for something, right?
In her constant observations of him, she had come to realize that several girls didn’t know he was stringing them along.

Was he only telling her because he thought she wouldn’t care? That it didn’t matter because she really was “easy?” No. No, that couldn’t be it. He actually liked her. She could tell. She could feel it.
But she’d been feeling all sorts of things with no payoff lately. Something had to change.
But was this “change” really a change at all? Or was her history of giving herself to anyone who showed any amount of interest just setting her up for disaster once more?
: Bye, Kyousuke! Bye, Tomo-kun! See you in lunch!
: Mmm! My bangs are acting up again. How am I supposed to face Koga-sensei like this?
: What are you talkin’ about?! You look fine! Just be yourself! That’s what boys really like, isn’t it?
: Tch, easy for you to say. You get to go home to a cool older brother and all of his cool friends who probably walk around shirtless and...chop wood and...ugh! These bangs!
: My brother and his friends do not walk around shirtless and chop wood. I’m just repeating what I’ve heard the guys say.
: There is zero way Kyousuke and Tomo-kun talk about liking girls who just “be themselves.” Boys our age only care about boobs.
: Y...Yeah...
: Yeah, I think we’re both kinda...done for in that department.
: See, this is why I like Koga-sensei. A distinguished gentleman like him is most definitely the type to appreciate a girl for her personality, not her chest.
: Why do you care so much about your bangs then?
: Shut up.
: Akemi, have you really not heard the rumors about him lately?
: Rumors? What rumors? I haven’t heard anything.
: Somebody saw Koga-sensei walking out of a love hotel with a high school girl last week.
: What?! No. No, that can’t be true! He would never!
: High school? Really? I thought you needed to be 18 to get into places like those.
: Fake ID maybe? I heard a lot of places don’t even check. They sit behind these window things and just take your money.
: Well, whatever you heard is definitely not true! Koga-sensei is refined and pure and-
: Uta! Come to the cafeteria with us! They have curry today!
: Maybe next time! I told one of the teachers I’d help them make copies of the handouts for tomorrow!
: Laaaaame! You’re still coming to Mizuya Chaya after school though, right?
: Yup! I’ll meet you guys there! Later!
: So effortless. How do you even do that?
: Who? Me? Do what?
: Talk to boys! Isn’t he the fieldstop for the school baseball team?
: Do you...mean shortstop?
: Whatever! You just talk to them like they’re no different from us! How?
: I...just do? I’ve never really thought about it.
: Suuuuure, Uta. Like we’re going to believe that.
: What?! I’m being serious! I’ve known him and most of the other guys in our class since kindergarten. They barely even register as boys to me.
: Mhm. Right. I’m sure that’s what Koga-sensei’s girlfriend would say too.
: Oh my god, Becki! Stop! Koga-sensei doesn’t have a girlfriend! He-
: Hey, do you guys know what time it is?
: Just look at the clock. I’m busy making myself beautiful.
: It’s 11:33. Fourth period is-
: Ahh, shoot! I didn’t realize it was that late! Sorry, guys! Gotta run! I told the teacher I’d have those copies done by next period!
: Okaaaay, but you’re still not forgiven for being friends with the baseball goalie!
: Are you just being dumb on purpose? Do you think that makes you cuter or something?
: Hey, have you heard the rumor about Koga-sensei?
: How he was caught leaving a hotel with some high school girl? Duuuuh. Everyone’s heard that by now.
: I heard he got called into the principal’s office and put on “administrative leave” last period.
: Ugh, thank God. I had an essay due.
: Hahah! Thank Ushibori, not me.
: Ushibori? You mean Uta? Why? What does she have to do with this?
: I heard from Kyousuke’s group this morning that it was probably her leaving that hotel with him, just wearing a different uniform as a disguise.
: Uta? Are we thinking of the same girl? Tomboy Uta? “Only hangs out with boys after school” Uta?
: That’s the one. You’ve seriously never noticed how close she is with like all of the male teachers? She clearly has a thing for older guys.
: No way. Kyousuke’s probably just trying to start something since she rejected him last year. Uta’s not like that.
: Hmm...do you think it could be like one of those compensated dating things then? Maybe her family’s poor? I heard her brother gets into a lot of fights. Maybe he’s in a gang or something?
: You’ve been talking to Becki too much. Uta’s just an average girl. I doubt she’d be able to land Koga-sensei even if he was into that.
: Maybe...I definitely wouldn’t blame her if she did nail him, though. I know I would. Koga-sensei is a total hottie.
: God, yes. Seven days a week.
: Hah...
: It was only a matter of time, Uta.
: You were always destined for this.
: Everyone’s always known.
: Why couldn’t you just be normal?
: Why couldn’t you just fall for a boy your own age and...
: Wait...
: He never said it back...
: He made me admit I love him...and he never even said it back.
: Whatever. First kiss — complete. Future Uta can figure out how to make him love her.
: That’s all she ever thinks about anyway.
Uta’s affection has increased by 10!
